name: Riverside Plaza
description: Galleria at Tyler is a prominent regional shopping destination in Riverside, California, serving the Inland Empire community with a comprehensive mix of national retailers, dining options, and entertainment. This enclosed mall provides a comfortable year-round shopping experience with convenient access and ample amenities for families and shoppers throughout the region.
demographics: Galleria at Tyler attracts a diverse middle to upper-middle income demographic, with primary visitors ranging from young families to mature adults aged 25-65. The trade area draws from Riverside's growing suburban communities with median household incomes between $55,000-$85,000, appealing to value-conscious shoppers seeking quality mainstream brands. The center serves as a regional destination for the Inland Empire, attracting visitors who prioritize convenience and variety in a traditional enclosed mall setting.
summary: Riverside Plaza at Galleria at Tyler is a major enclosed regional mall serving the Inland Empire with diverse shopping, dining, and entertainment options.
